A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to conduct a public hearing, introduce for first reading, proceed by title only, and
  waive reading in full of Ordinance No. 2026­623, amending Section 18.90.080 of the Hawaiian
  Gardens Municipal Code relating to Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling
  Units to comply with the recent changes in state law, and finding the action to be statutorily exempt
  from CEQA under Public Resources Code § 21080.17.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, to approve
  recommendation.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; De Paula, Farfan, Vargas, Roa, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

  by title and further reading waived.

being held on February 11; and that February 13 is the deadline for the Youth and Adult Scholarship
Program.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, provided an update on resuming the YAL program; and
announced some dos and don’ts for coyote sightings.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided updates on the SCAG STBG Street Rehabilitation
project; FY 2024­25 Arterial Street Improvements bid opening; and Christmas Tree planting survey.

McDonald's, and by the riverbed.

on Wednesday, February 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
